definitions.gloss: to firmly believe, to be convinced, to be under the impression
definitions.explanation: To believe something completely without doubt, often regardless of whether it is actually true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was convinced that I was right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺師|さぎし}→詐欺師：10176_sagishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{信|しん}じ{込|こ}んで⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{騙|だま}し{取|と}られた。
examples.english: I believed the scammer's story completely and was cheated out of money.

notes:
{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む is a compound verb with ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ adding the sense of thoroughness or completion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む / X⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{信|しん}じ{込|こ}む

ASPECT (ている):
- {信|しん}じ{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is firmly convinced (state)

USAGE:
Often implies blind or possibly mistaken belief. More emphatic than ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ alone.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe
- ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧: suffix adding completeness/thoroughness
